materials.hardware: aged iron, polished brass, and restrained copper
materials.lenses: dark teal glass with small highlights

prohibited_changes: do not change citizen movement, tasks, animation timing, navigation, combat, role assignment, or identity
do not change the production half-inch citizen scale or animated pivot contract
do not replace independently controlled role equipment with art geometry
do not alter collision, selection, room surface data, or floor navigation
do not fall back to an unregistered legacy citizen when the accepted asset cannot load
required_features: five named animated mesh pivots Body, LeftArm, RightArm, LeftLeg, and RightLeg at the established miniature scale
recognizable human head, torso, separate arms and legs, fitted boots, and distinct head silhouette
clockwork cap and two brass-framed lenses with readable glass contrast
layered tailored fabric and leather with deliberate seams, lapels, fasteners, and role badge space
textured fabric and leather with visually separate brass, iron, skin, and glass materials
role tool, backpack, cargo, chest badge, and traversal clip remain independently attached by the production citizen rig
visible at the actual close, room, builder, cargo, and climbing views with 50 active citizens
visual_target: A polished half-inch RoomScale clockwork worker with a readable human silhouette, tailored textured coat, warm face, brass-framed twin goggles, a distinctive clockwork cap, fitted gloves and boots, and restrained mechanical detailing. It must remain legible in a 50-citizen room at ordinary camera distance and reward close inspection without losing its rig pivots.
